newsitem.title: USA: Ford recalls 5,300 Econoline vans; 1,300 Villagers.
newsitem.headline: Ford recalls 5,300 Econoline vans; 1,300 Villagers.

text.p: Ford Motor Co said Tuesday it is recalling about 5,300 1997 Econoline vans equipped with a 4.2L engine and about 1,300 1997 Mercury Villagers.

The battery cable harnesses installed in the Econoline vehicles may contact and be damaged by the right engine mount. This may allow the cable to develop a short to ground. A short could result in overheating of the wiring, and potentially ignite surrounding components, Ford said in a statement.
Ford said it is unaware of any accidents or injuries related to this concern.

Ford also said it is recalling about 1,300 1997 Mercury Villagers. Rubber hoses connected to the fuel tank may have been heat damaged by the supplier and may develop cracks or splits that potentially could result in fuel leaks.
Ford said it is unaware of any accidents or injuries related to this concern.
Owners of affected vehicles are being contacted by first-class mail and requested to return their vehicles to their dealer for inspection and appropriate repair, free of charge, Ford said.
